column1: # INCOMPLETE AND PARTLY MIS-ATTRIBUTED -- see round 465 in PACKET_FORMAT.md.
#  1. Appends are attributed to the ENCLOSING FUNCTION, but a function can write
#     to two different messages (one it opens via slot 0x278, one a helper opens).
#     Such a row mixes both payloads. This is what made 0xb069/0xb06a/0xb47b look
#     like disagreements against the client; they agree once split.
#  2. A SECOND message-open idiom is not detected at all: allocate through slot
#     0x48 on a global, then write the opcode to **(buf + 0x1050). 258 sites,
#     65 distinct opcodes, 57 of them absent from this table entirely.
# So: 203 opcodes here, at least 260 exist. Treat a row as a lead, not a layout.
